nina_cs: Heads-up from onboarding call with Meridian Labs — 30m. They listed three items blocking go-live for additional teams.

nina_cs: Items: 1) per-project cost exports; 2) granular billing alerts by route; 3) clearer export field names for finance ingestion.

karen_finance: their CFO said "we can't map the current invoice to GL codes without a route-level file" - that's a renewal gating item.

omar_prod: can you paste raw asks + severity and whether a stopgap CSV would work?

nina_cs: raw: per-project CSV (daily) with fields project, route, tokens, cost_estimate, timestamp; severity: high; workaround: manual tagging. billing alerts: email when project > $X/day; severity: medium. export field names: they want column names matching GL codes; severity: medium-low.

ben_eng: can do daily CSV to S3 in ~3d (MVP). alerts need metrics wiring, ~2 sprints. mapping template is easy, nina pls collect their GL mapping.

nina_cs: will collect mapping and upload sample. attaching recording link: https://redwood.example.com/recordings/meridian-2026-03-23

attachments-bot: uploaded "meridian_sample_map.csv" (2 KB)

omar_prod: great — i'll create an epic for CSV export MVP and tag finance acceptance. thanks.
